instruction: I am planning to buy a few things on amazon for my company's camping trip next week. I have drafted an email to my manager listing the items for confirmation, but the draft is missing individual prices. Please update them in the TODO placeholders and send the email.
notes: The draft (already addressed to the manager) lists items as '- <qty> X <name> => TODO'. The agent reads the draft, looks up each item's price on Amazon via search_products (no access token needed, so no amazon login is modeled), computes qty x unit price, rewrites the body with the totals via update_draft, and sends with send_email_from_draft (which deletes the draft and creates the email, matching the required DB changes). Because STRIPS cannot quantify over 'all items priced', the items form an ordered chain (price-cursor / next-product) ending in a sentinel product no-more-items; update_draft is only enabled once the cursor reaches the sentinel. The problem shows 3 items; more items are added by extending the chain in :init only. complete_task carries no answer; its draft parameter is a task record, not an API argument.
